title: Pass SG: blind annotation of the twelve core units (Claude Sonnet 5.5, golden inputs)
question: Does Sonnet 5.5, with the same golden inputs as passes A, B and H, annotate the core units closer to the Opus passes than Haiku does?
method: Fresh subagent with golden inputs identical to pass H's (only output paths changed); batches validated by code/s0_check.py; first versions kept.
commands: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0_check.py results/s0/pass_sg --out results/s0/stored/pass_sg

agents.separation: fresh subagent; read only its input folder and output folder (transcript audit of every file opened, 2026-10-28); listed the file names in inputs/ and code/ once, opening none; wrote only its output folder

conclusion: Twelve valid batches; five needed format repair after the first validation run (scope as object, evidence role, condition leaf field, units in parameter values, two-argument independence).
